title: Two more projects in the community directory
summary:
Two community projects joined the directory, while the MCP and text-to-speech guides got more accurate.

The project listings added Aiphoto智能绘画, which generates images from Chinese descriptions, and SingodiyaTech, a Telegram bot offering AI features.

The MCP guides now list the community-maintained MCPollinations server alongside the official server, and clarify the official install command. An outdated website example was removed.

The text-to-speech POST docs now show that /openai returns JSON containing base64-encoded audio, not a raw MP3. The cURL, Python, and JavaScript examples show how to decode it.
